about.title: Behind the repairs, family owned.
text: BCM Marine & Powersports Service was established in 2018 with one mission: to bring a reliable and high quality service to the Clear Lake and Galveston area. Our passion for boating and powersports is what inspired us to open our business, and it continues to drive us to this day.

We have grown to become a well known boat repair company in the Clear Lake area. Our mission is simple: to provide the best customer experience possible and the highest quality repairs. We pride ourselves on being a family business that treats each customer how we want to be treated.
All our repairs are completed with meticulous detail, so you can spend more time doing what you enjoy, playing on the water or riding in the mud.
